User Stories: As a user, I want to browse the clothing catalog.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display all available items with images and metadata (FR-3.1, FR-3.2).
Steps to Test:
1. Navigate to Catalog Browser
2. Verify items and images display

User Stories: As a user, I want to filter items by category, size, and price.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall update the display to show only matching items (FR-3.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Catalog
2. Apply category filter
3. Apply size filter
4. Apply price filter
5. Verify results match

User Stories: As a user, I want to filter items. I applied filters that match no items.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display "No items match your filters" and offer to clear filters (UC-02 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Catalog
2. Apply a filter combination with no matches
3. Verify message and clear-filters option

User Stories: As a user, I want to view full details of an item.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display name, description, price, store name, metadata, and two-view images (FR-3.2).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Catalog
2. Click an item
3. Verify full details and two-view images

User Stories: As a user, I want to open a Seller's Store page.
Acceptance Criteria: The Store page shall list only that Seller's active items (FR-3.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Open an item detail
2. Click the store name
3. Verify only that Seller's active items appear

User Stories: As a user, I want to browse the catalog. The catalog has no items.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display "No items available" (UC-02 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Seed an empty catalog
2. Open Catalog Browser
3. Verify empty-state message

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to browse the catalog without registering.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall allow Guests read-only catalog access; no registration required (FR-1.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Continue as Guest
2. Open Catalog
3. Browse and filter items

User Stories: As a regular user, I want to know I cannot upload catalog images.
Acceptance Criteria: System shall not expose image upload endpoints or UI to Users/Guests (FR-3.4).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in as User.
2. Inspect UI for upload buttons.
3. Attempt POST to Seller upload API endpoint.

User Stories: As a user, I want Store pages to be isolated.
Acceptance Criteria: Store page shall list ONLY that specific Seller's active items (FR-3.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Seller A's Store page.
2. Verify no items from Seller B appear.
3. Repeat for Seller B.
